evals.prompt: Parse this paper PDF, extract the experiment information, and give me both a summary and the structured JSON. File: data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf
evals.expected_output: Check AMINER_API_KEY, run scripts/ocr.py on the PDF, write result.md / response.json / images/, extract experiments.json with no justification fields, then reply with a Markdown summary, an experiment summary, the full JSON in a json code block, and artifact paths.
expectations: Checked that AMINER_API_KEY is set before calling the script
Ran scripts/ocr.py with --input pointing at the given PDF
Wrote result.md, response.json, and experiments.json under outputs/aminer-pdf-ocr/SCIREX/
Chat reply includes a short Markdown summary of the paper
Chat reply includes the full experiments.json object in a json code block, not only a summary
Structured JSON has no justification keys

evals.prompt: OCR this PDF and extract experiments: data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf. I have not set AMINER_API_KEY.
evals.expected_output: Detect that AMINER_API_KEY is missing; stop immediately; do not run ocr.py; tell the user to generate a token at https://open.aminer.cn/open/board?tab=control and export AMINER_API_KEY=<token>. Never print a real token, host, or IP.
expectations: Reported that AMINER_API_KEY is missing
Did not run scripts/ocr.py
Did not fabricate OCR text or experiment JSON
Pointed the user to https://open.aminer.cn/open/board?tab=control
Did not hardcode a PDF OCR host or IP in the reply

evals.prompt: Extract the experiments from that machine learning paper I mentioned.
evals.expected_output: No local file or URL was given. Stop and ask the user for a PDF/JPG/PNG path or http(s) URL. Do not invent an input file.
expectations: Did not run scripts/ocr.py
Asked the user for a local file path or URL
Did not invent a PDF path or fabricate experiment JSON

evals.expected_output: Run OCR only. Write result.md and related OCR artifacts. Skip experiment extraction. Do not write experiments.json or paste experiment JSON.
expectations: Ran scripts/ocr.py on the given PDF
Did not write experiments.json
Did not present a full experiment JSON object
Told the user the OCR artifact paths (result.md / response.json / images/)

evals.prompt: 请解析这篇论文并抽取实验信息，输入：data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf
evals.expected_output: Handle Chinese input with the same pipeline: OCR then extract. User-facing summary may be Chinese; JSON keys stay English. Reply must still include the full structured JSON.
expectations: Ran scripts/ocr.py on data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf
Wrote experiments.json
JSON keys are English (research_problem, experiments, methods, datasets, metrics)
Chat reply includes the full JSON in a json code block
JSON has no justification fields

evals.prompt: Parse data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf but keep the queue backoff short. max-upload-attempts: 2 output: outputs/aminer-pdf-ocr/applsci/summary.json
evals.expected_output: Run ocr.py with --max-upload-attempts 2 and --output. The open API parses whole documents only; page ranges are not supported, so do not pass --start-page-id/--end-page-id. Still present Markdown summary, experiment summary, and full JSON.
expectations: Called scripts/ocr.py with --max-upload-attempts 2 and --output
Did not pass --start-page-id or --end-page-id (unsupported by the open API)
Did not invent scores or datasets absent from the parsed document
Chat reply includes the full experiments.json object

evals.prompt: Are the references in data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf real? Please verify the citations.
evals.expected_output: Do not use this skill for citation verification. Route the user to pdf-citation-verifier. Do not run PDF OCR for this request.
expectations: Did not run scripts/ocr.py for citation verification
Told the user to use pdf-citation-verifier
Did not fabricate REAL/FAKE citation labels

evals.expected_output: After AMINER_API_KEY exists, the script should fail because the local file is missing. Surface the error verbatim. Do not extract or invent experiments.
expectations: Did not present a fabricated result.md or experiments.json
Reported that the local file was not found (or equivalent script error)
Did not invent experiment fields

evals.prompt: Convert https://example.com/paper.pdf to Markdown and extract the experimental setup.
evals.expected_output: Run ocr.py with the URL as --input (script downloads then uploads). If download/parse succeeds, extract experiments and paste the full JSON. If download fails, report the error verbatim.
expectations: Passed the http(s) URL to scripts/ocr.py --input
Did not skip the script and pretend to OCR the URL in-chat
On success, reply includes full experiments.json; on failure, reports the script error without fabricated JSON

evals.prompt: I only want a brief recap of the experiments in data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf. Do not dump JSON.
evals.expected_output: Still run OCR + extraction. A brief recap is allowed, but the skill requires the full structured JSON in the reply anyway. Write experiments.json and paste the unmodified object.
expectations: Ran OCR and experiment extraction
Chat reply still includes the full experiments.json in a json code block
Did not omit the JSON just because the user asked for a recap

evals.prompt: Parse data/pdf/applsci-14-11736.pdf and fill justification quotes for every method and dataset.
evals.expected_output: Run the normal extraction schema which has no justification fields. Do not add research_problem_justification, methods[].justification, or datasets[].justification.
expectations: Wrote experiments.json using the current schema
Output JSON does not contain any justification keys
Chat reply includes the full structured JSON

evals.expected_output: Run ocr.py with --no-save-images, then extract experiments from result.md. Present Markdown summary, experiment summary, full JSON, and artifact paths.
expectations: Called scripts/ocr.py with --no-save-images
Still wrote result.md and experiments.json
Chat reply includes the full experiments.json object
JSON keys stay English and include research_problem and experiments
